## Design

### 2026-10-13 – So first I started with the brainstorming, how am I going to design around these constraints: Antenna, power, SD card, and ventilation and cooling.

**3h**

So first I started with the brainstorming, how am I going to design around these constraints: Antenna, power, SD card, and ventilation and cooling.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/PyBRq8PPAIR10a85zVadomccKWQcxryn/9597cf51669b779e862081fa6d9c4c3fe9ba638a6eacda455c1d6c58748661e2.png)

So, in the image below is my V1 design that only accounts for the antenna that will communicate with my computer and send telemetry back and forth. This also means that if the SD were to fail, the data would be received to my computer, hopefully!

![WhatsApp Image 2026-10-13 at 10.49.43 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/PyBRq8PPAIR10a85zVadomccKWQcxryn/842a45f340d3f8eb81b76aede9d56902ffde0779315fd40db71b9d7fd4595b36.jpg)

The next image is my V2 design in where it also uses the idea that the screw terminal block will pop out and to account for that I made sure to cut and opening for it

![WhatsApp Image 2026-10-13 at 10.57.40 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/PyBRq8PPAIR10a85zVadomccKWQcxryn/0c12faf131607917b12cff5f4458fb3300262a8b0e7ee8e7f3c30417700775f1.jpg)

### 2026-10-16 – Still doing PCB brainstorming. I have created a v3 design then I have moved to a final version that should be perfect and should fit in nicely.

**4h**

Still doing PCB brainstorming. I have created a v3 design then I have moved to a final version that should be perfect and should fit in nicely.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-10-16 at 10.18.21 AM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/PyBRq8PPAIR10a85zVadomccKWQcxryn/2bdd590f1b45ae9f31e3eb0f4f882324ae5af24742377c8863a478b1730cb0fa.jpg)

The image above shows a v3 design that has vents on 4 sides to hopefully make sure that it doesn't overheat, and now I have also created an SD card slot hole so that it doesn't need me to remove the whole board then to put and SD card in. There is also mounting holes so that board isn't just sitting there.

![WhatsAppP Image 2026-10-16 at 10.18.21 AM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/PyBRq8PPAIR10a85zVadomccKWQcxryn/d40a0f830a6761d0dfdd3dbb2047c7ca6f13e75b21f6a067efe60b8c3a615412.jpg)

The final design will have a small fan for cooling since it'll be enclosed and could overheat, the fan will be extremely useful.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/PyBRq8PPAIR10a85zVadomccKWQcxryn/d69d83f0b6f3bf63111c380a40610e3f9f2df8019163c2071500d42d8a2745d7.png)

I decided to use onshape rather than fusion, since its simpler, and tinkercad since onshape has more tools to use.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/PyBRq8PPAIR10a85zVadomccKWQcxryn/b949355fb62ee1801e9e3506ab6a5660c76a9ef6ded6fd1f37f0a70b4ecbd4ae.png)

Watched a youtube video and got the bascic of onshape and will begin locking in now!
